var ControlReason = /* @__PURE__ */ function(ControlReason) {
	ControlReason[ControlReason["No"] = 0] = "No";
	ControlReason[ControlReason["Yes"] = 1] = "Yes";
	return ControlReason;
}({});
function choose(value) {
	if (value > 0) return ControlReason.Yes;
	return ControlReason.No;
}
function nested(value) {
	if (value > 0) {
		if (value > 10) return 10;
		return 1;
	}
	return 0;
}
function neverCalled(value) {
	return value > 0 ? 3 : 4;
}
//#endregion
//#region src/outside-control.ts
function outsideCore() {
	return 5;
}
//#endregion
export { ControlReason, choose, nested, neverCalled, outsideCore };
